sections.description: The Event Planner Theme offers a structured website layout with sections designed to organize schedules, announcements, speakers, galleries, testimonials, contact details, and event information. Its responsive framework ensures content adjusts across various screen sizes while maintaining a consistent browsing experience. The theme includes customizable headers, footers, menus, banners, and typography settings, allowing visual adjustments without editing core files. Multiple page templates and widget-ready areas provide flexibility for arranging different types of content. Additional features include blog support, social media integration, image galleries, countdown sections, pricing tables, and contact form compatibility. The clean coding structure helps maintain performance and supports integration with commonly used plugins. Built-in customization settings make it possible to modify colors, layouts, backgrounds, and branding elements according to project requirements. Translation-ready files, browser compatibility, and accessibility considerations improve usability across different audiences and devices. The theme also supports media-rich content, making it suitable for displaying photos, videos, and promotional material in an organized manner. Overall, it focuses on providing practical website functionality through flexible layouts, straightforward customization options, and a well-structured design.
